decision_definitions.semantic_correct: Visible mathematical solution (including statements/hint and step expression-result consistency) and data meaning are correct; harmless wording/schema/placeholder-unit issues are reported separately.
decision_definitions.severe_error: Wrong/absent answer, materially wrong entity, false displayed mathematical step, wrong stated formula/concept or wrong diagnosis of observed student work. Format-only, grade-level formality and minor wording alone are not severe.
decision_definitions.instruction_followed: Attempts the requested worked solution with requested structured fields and Vietnamese guidance; schema/language failures and absent requested vertical calculation guidance fail separately from mathematical correctness.
decision_definitions.grade_appropriate: AI pedagogical judgment of the displayed method for assigned grade; formal simultaneous equations and multiplication beyond basic assigned grade without support fail. This is not certification of the engineered grade assignment.
decision_definitions.final_numeric_correct: Manual mathematical meaning of the visible final value; includes readable invalid-JSON final values and Western grouping interpretation where context proves intended integer. This is supplemental and NEVER replaces raw frozen parser metrics.
decision_definitions.meaningful_unit_correct: Actual quantity unit/clear dimensionlessness; unit, số, phân số, tỉ số, tỷ lệ and other placeholders/types do not count as correct units. Units meaninglessly invented from pure numbers fail.
decision_definitions.step_by_step_guidance_useful: Explains operation selection and enough steps at assigned level; mathematically false steps, overly formal methods or bare answers to vertical/decimal algorithm requests fail.
